summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 4: Product/Menu Item Catalog screens. All 21 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend features tested and working: Menu page with category tabs, sold out/seasonal badges, product detail gallery with carousel, admin catalog CRUD, admin auth protection.
critical_code_review_comments: All frontend API calls correctly use relative URLs (/api/...) to avoid CORS issues with Kubernetes ingress
Admin routes properly protected with role check in AdminLayout - non-admin users redirected to /
Sold out items correctly show grayscale image, SOLD OUT badge, no add button on both menu and detail pages
Seasonal items show SEASONAL badge correctly
Product gallery carousel works with prev/next arrows, dot indicators, and thumbnail clicks
Admin catalog table shows all 10 items with toggle, edit, delete actions
Admin search and category filters work correctly
Admin Add/Edit forms have all required fields: name, description, price, category, status, tags, images
Edit form correctly pre-fills with existing item data including images array
seed_data_creation: 10 menu items seeded on startup in test_database.menu_items collection. Item item-007 is sold_out, item-003 is seasonal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 catalog CRUD fully tested. All features working: (1) Menu page at /menu loads 10 items from API with category tabs (All Offerings, Starters, Mains, Drinks, Desserts), (2) Category filtering works via API query param, (3) Sold out item (item-007 Spiced Lamb Kofta) shows grayscale image, SOLD OUT overlay, no add button, (4) Seasonal item (item-003 Earth Harvest Bowl) shows SEASONAL badge, (5) Product detail page shows gallery with carousel arrows, dot indicators, thumbnails, (6) Sold out detail page shows grayscale, SOLD OUT badge, no add-to-order, sold out message, (7) Admin at /admin redirects to /login if not authenticated, (8) Admin only accessible to admin role users (non-admin redirected to /), (9) Admin catalog at /admin/catalog shows table with all 10 items, search, category filters, toggle, edit/delete, (10) Admin Add/Edit forms work with all fields. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED (visual placeholders only).
